tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Workspace ground: warm off-white in light, deep navy in dark (never pure white or black). Behind maps, diagrams and tables.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, drawers, the mission composer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: map ground, code/data blocks, inactive tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between panels. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, chart axes (3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, units, axis labels on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary labels on surface and surface-raised only (4.5:1); disabled text.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: PRIMARY brand accent as a FILL: primary button, active stage, selected scenario, selected site. Text on it is on-saffron. Max one saffron fill per view region.

tokens.name: saffron-strong
tokens.usage: Saffron as a stroke or mark (3:1): active flow path, opportunity series in charts, focused node outline, the mark's tail.

tokens.name: saffron-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron as text: opportunity values and labels on surfaces and saffron-soft.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind opportunity tags and the current stage.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a saffron fill (6.9:1 light, 8.5:1 dark). Never white.

tokens.name: ashoka
tokens.usage: Brand navy as a large fill: app icon tile, brand moments, cover slab. Text on it is on-ashoka.

tokens.name: on-ashoka
tokens.usage: Text and marks on ashoka and nav-surface.

tokens.name: nav-surface
tokens.usage: Navigation rail and top bar.

tokens.name: nav-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav labels and icons on nav-surface.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: SYSTEM / INTELLIGENCE: links, info states, system data series, network links on maps, AI-activity indicators. As text on surfaces and blue-soft.

tokens.name: blue-2
tokens.usage: Secondary system series and reference connectors (3:1 on surfaces). Pair with blue, never alone as text.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind system tags, info banners, selected table rows.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: POSITIVE / SUSTAINABLE only: recovered waste, reduced emissions, saved water, viable circular path, validated completion. Text on surfaces and green-soft. Never decoration.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind positive tags and discovered circularity nodes.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: ASSUMPTION / UNCERTAINTY: assumption tags, dashed assumption bands, attention states. Text on surfaces and amber-soft. Always with the ≈ glyph or a dashed border so it is never confused with saffron.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind assumption tags and attention banners.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: ENVIRONMENTAL RISK / FAILURE / CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: risk tags, increases in emissions or water, errors. Text on surfaces and red-soft. Always with ▲ or ! and a word.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind risk tags and error banners.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Unavailable, inactive, unknown, baseline. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (10:1 light, 7:1 dark on surface-raised).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Underlined on hover and always in body copy.

tokens.name: viz-opportunity
tokens.usage: Chart series: economic opportunity, selected scenario.

tokens.name: viz-system
tokens.usage: Chart series: system and reference data (primary).

tokens.name: viz-system-2
tokens.usage: Chart series: second system/reference series.

tokens.name: viz-positive
tokens.usage: Chart series: environmental improvement, recovered value.

tokens.name: viz-risk
tokens.usage: Chart series: degradation, risk, increase of a harmful quantity.

tokens.name: viz-assumption
tokens.usage: Chart overlays: assumption bands and ranges (always dashed).

tokens.name: viz-baseline
tokens.usage: Chart series: baseline / business-as-usual reference.

tokens.name: scene-ground
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: the top of every plinth (map, ecosystem, factory floor).

tokens.name: scene-plinth
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: plinth sides — the slab that makes a scene read as a model, not a screenshot.

tokens.name: scene-building
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: building and machine bodies (white-model architecture).

tokens.name: scene-roof
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: roofs, stacked goods, secondary volumes.

tokens.name: scene-glass
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: glazing bands, solar panels.

tokens.name: scene-machine
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: steel — pylons, machine heads, chimneys.

tokens.name: scene-field
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: agricultural land (raw materials). Never green — green is earned.

tokens.name: scene-sea
tokens.usage: 3D scenes: sea beside ports.

tokens.name: flow-material
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: material and product moving (bale-shaped packets).

tokens.name: flow-energy
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: grid electricity (pulse packets along conduits).

tokens.name: flow-renewable
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: renewable electricity — green because it is a sustainability gain.

tokens.name: flow-water
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: water in, recovered water back (drop packets). The only resource-specific hue; 3:1 on surface and scene-ground in both themes.

tokens.name: flow-waste
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: waste leaving a process, before any value is found.

tokens.name: flow-circular
tokens.usage: Flow grammar: a VALIDATED circular pathway (waste → value). Only after discovery.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI discovery layer: the system's own markers, construction feed, analysing states.

tokens.name: simulated
tokens.usage: SIMULATED values and ghosts — always dashed or hatched, always tagged SIM; CURRENT stays solid ink.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Brand moments only: the Command Center title, the cover, slide titles.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: Headline industrial metrics (capacity, tonnes recovered, ₹ crore). Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cutting waste can become recycled yarn within 180 km.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Source: illustrative dataset, not live government data.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Values inside metric tiles, table totals.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Coordinates, IDs, formulas in the Evidence Drawer, evidence kind labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag padding-x.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panels in a workspace.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section separation, cover insets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Command Center vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level whitespace on brand moments.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, map site squares.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The mission composer, modal sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Nodes, rings, the stage dots — circles only.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised panels on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Evidence Drawer, popovers, the mission composer at rest.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Navigation rail.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Evidence Drawer.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and toasts.
